SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
WHERE
  orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name,
  orders.customer_id
ORDER BY
  "orders.customers.regions.name" ASC,
  "orders.revenue" DESC
LIMIT 21

SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_s1 AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.revenue" AS "revenue"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    WHERE
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT customers__regions.name IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      customers__regions.name,
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."s1.customers__regions__name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name" AS "revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s1.customers__regions__name AS "s1.customers__regions__name",
      SUM(s1.revenue) AS "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name"
    FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
    GROUP BY
      s1.customers__regions__name
  ) AS _stage_inner
), base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    s1.customer_id AS "s1.customer_id",
    s1.customers__regions__name AS "s1.customers__regions__name",
    SUM(s1.revenue) AS "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name"
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  GROUP BY
    s1.customer_id,
    s1.customers__regions__name
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "s1.customer_id",
    "s1.customers__regions__name",
    "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name",
    CASE
      WHEN "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name" IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "s1.customers__regions__name", CASE
          WHEN "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name" IS NULL
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
        ORDER BY "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name" DESC
      )
    END AS "s1.rank"
  FROM base_2
), _cm_rank AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."s1.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."s1.customers__regions__name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."s1.rank" AS "rank"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "s1.customer_id",
      "s1.customers__regions__name",
      "s1.rank"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        "s1.customer_id",
        "s1.customers__regions__name",
        "s1.revenue_sum_partition_by_customer_id_customers__regions__name",
        "s1.rank"
      FROM step1
    ) AS _outer
  ) AS _stage_inner
), __slayer_stage_s2 AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."s1.customers__regions__name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."s1.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."s1.revenue" AS "revenue",
    _stage_inner."s1.share" AS "share",
    _stage_inner."s1.rnk" AS "rnk"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s1.customers__regions__name AS "s1.customers__regions__name",
      s1.customer_id AS "s1.customer_id",
      s1.revenue AS "s1.revenue",
      s1.revenue / _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name" AS "s1.share",
      _cm_rank."rank" AS "s1.rnk"
    FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
    LEFT JOIN _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name
      ON s1.customers__regions__name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."customers__regions__name"
    LEFT JOIN _cm_rank
      ON s1.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_rank."customer_id"
      AND s1.customers__regions__name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_rank."customers__regions__name"
    GROUP BY
      s1.customers__regions__name,
      s1.customer_id,
      s1.revenue,
      s1.revenue / _cm_revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."revenue_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name",
      _cm_rank."rank"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  s2.customers__regions__name AS "s2.customers__regions__name",
  s2.customer_id AS "s2.customer_id",
  s2.revenue AS "s2.revenue",
  s2.share AS "s2.share",
  s2.rnk AS "s2.rnk"
FROM __slayer_stage_s2 AS s2
WHERE
  s2.rnk <= 2
GROUP BY
  s2.customers__regions__name,
  s2.customer_id,
  s2.revenue,
  s2.share,
  s2.rnk
ORDER BY
  "s2.customers__regions__name" ASC,
  "s2.rnk" ASC
LIMIT 21
